market_summary: USD-denominated assets and crypto experienced aggressive intraday liquidation during the New York session, leaving all assets deeply below their daily VWAPs and Value Area Lows. XAUUSD presents an actionable trend continuation sell setup following a corrective retest of its GEX Gamma Flip in a negative amplifying regime. EURUSD, GBPUSD, and BTCUSD are displaying oversold pauses and minor delta absorption above their session lows, warranting patience for better pullback structures.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7-point confluence checklist: 1) Volume Profile: Price is trading at 3876.32, well below VAL (3911.54) and below POC (3978.13). 2) CVD: Header shows CVD -8.24 (BEARISH) with positive short-term slope (+1.24) indicating a minor corrective bounce. 3) Session: NEW_YORK_SESSION provides strong liquidity and high execution priority. 4) Trend / baselines: Price is trading significantly below both VWAP (3939.27) and EMA50 (3924.90), both sloping down. 5) ATR: Consolidating near the lower ATR band (3869.69) after a strong expansion drive. 6) RVOL: Last bar RVOL is 0.921, but the broader breakdown was confirmed by prior high-volume spikes. 7) GEX & S/R: GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING with Gamma Flip at 3880.36; price is below the flip, testing and rejecting just underneath it. Put Wall #1 sits lower at 3826.03 leaving ample downside room toward Session Low (3852.35). Entering short on this intraday pullback toward the Gamma Flip.
